opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead research and email draft
opportunities.description: For a given GitHub username, search users, open the profile and top repo, then compose a hiring lead email with followers, top repo stats and latest post for a given role.
steps: Click global search and type the username, press Enter
Note followers count and latest post
Open top repository and note stars and language
Open mail compose, enter To hiring@example.com
Enter body summarizing followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post

opportunities.name: Person Wikipedia + Wayback snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, view an Internet Archive snapshot of a related website for a given year, and save a combined note.
steps: Search the person's name on Wikipedia and read the summary
Open web.archive.org and enter the site domain
Select the year and pick a snapshot date
Read the headline content on the archived page
Open notes, create new note with person facts and site snapshot headline, press Enter
